text_en: Simon heard that Trypho had assembled a large army to invade the land of Judah and destroy it,
text_cn: 息孟听说特黎丰集合大军，要来扫荡犹太地，

text_en: and he saw that the people were trembling with fear. So he went up to Jerusalem, and gathering the people together
text_cn: 又见百姓战兢害怕，就上了耶路撒冷，召集民众，

text_en: he encouraged them, saying to them, “You yourselves know what great things my brothers and I and the house of my father have done for the laws and the sanctuary; you know also the wars and the difficulties that my brothers and I have seen.
text_cn: 劝勉他们说：“你们都知道，我与我的兄弟及我父全家，为法律，为圣所所作的事，所经的战争和艰难。

text_en: By reason of this all my brothers have perished for the sake of Israel, and I alone am left.
text_cn: 为这个缘故，我所有的兄弟，都为以色列而殉难，只剩下我一人。

text_en: And now, far be it from me to spare my life in any time of distress, for I am not better than my brothers.
text_cn: 现在，在整个灾难期中，我决不顾惜我的生命，虽然我并不比我的兄弟们强，

text_en: But I will avenge my nation and the sanctuary and your wives and children, for all the nations have gathered together out of hatred to destroy us. ”
text_cn: 但是我要为我的民族，为圣所，并为你们的妻子儿女报仇，因为一切的异民，都为了仇恨我们，而聚集起来，要消灭我们。”

text_en: The spirit of the people was rekindled when they heard these words,
text_cn: 民众听了这些话，精神都振作起来，

text_en: and they answered in a loud voice, “You are our leader in place of Judas and your brother Jonathan.
text_cn: 大声回答说：“你要代替你的兄弟犹大和约纳堂，作我们的领袖，

text_en: Fight our battles, and all that you say to us we will do. ”
text_cn: 为我们作战。凡你吩咐的，我们都要照办。”

text_en: So he assembled all the warriors and hurried to complete the walls of Jerusalem, and he fortified it on every side.
text_cn: 息孟于是召集众战士，又催促人们赶快完成耶路撒冷的城墙，并在四周设防。

text_en: He sent Jonathan son of Absalom to Joppa, and with him a considerable army; he drove out its occupants and remained there.
text_cn: 他又打发阿贝沙隆的儿子约纳堂，带着足够的军队，到约培去，将城中的人赶走，然后驻扎在那里。

text_en: Then Trypho left Ptolemais with a large army to invade the land of Judah, and Jonathan was with him under guard.
text_cn: 特黎丰离开仆托肋买，带着大军，要侵入犹太地，且押着约纳堂与他同去。

text_en: Simon encamped in Adida, facing the plain.
text_cn: 那时，息孟在平原对面的哈狄得扎营。

text_en: Trypho learned that Simon had risen up in place of his brother Jonathan, and that he was about to join battle with him, so he sent envoys to him and said,
text_cn: 特黎丰知道息孟起来，承继了他弟弟约纳堂的职位，准备与自己决战，就打发使者到他那里说：

text_en: “It is for the money that your brother Jonathan owed the royal treasury, in connection with the offices he held, that we are detaining him.
text_cn: “我们逮捕了你弟弟约纳堂，是因为他在所尽职务上，欠了国王的银子。

text_en: Send now one hundred talents of silver and two of his sons as hostages, so that when released he will not revolt against us, and we will release him. ”
text_cn: 现在你若送来一百‘塔冷通’银子，并将他的两个孩子送来作质，我们就释放他，免得他被释放后，再背叛我们。”

text_en: Simon knew that they were speaking deceitfully to him, but he sent to get the money and the sons, so that he would not arouse great hostility among the people, who might say,
text_cn: 息孟明知使者们对他说的，都是欺诈的话，但仍派人去取银钱，并将孩子带来，免得惹起民众的怨恨，

text_en: “It was because Simon did not send him the money and the sons, that Jonathan perished. ”
text_cn: 说：“约纳堂死了，是因为息孟没有将银钱和孩子送去。”

text_en: So he sent the sons and the hundred talents, but Trypho broke his word and did not release Jonathan.
text_cn: 所以他便将孩子和一百‘塔冷通’银子送去；可是，特黎丰这骗子，并没有释放约纳堂。

text_en: After this Trypho came to invade the country and destroy it, and he circled around by the way to Adora. But Simon and his army kept marching along opposite him to every place he went.
text_cn: 此后，特黎丰仍要进侵犹太疆域，加以扫荡，便在通往阿多辣去的路上，绕道而行；但是，不论往哪里去，息孟和他的军队总是追踪而至。

text_en: Now the men in the citadel kept sending envoys to Trypho urging him to come to them by way of the wilderness and to send them food.
text_cn: 那时，堡垒里的人打发使者到特黎丰那里，催他赶快经过旷野，来到他们那里，并将食粮给他们送来。

text_en: So Trypho got all his cavalry ready to go, but that night a very heavy snow fell, and he did not go because of the snow. He marched off and went into the land of Gilead.
text_cn: 特黎丰就准备了他的全部马队前往。但是那一夜，大雪纷飞，因此不能前进，遂起程往基肋阿得去了。

text_en: When he approached Baskama, he killed Jonathan, and he was buried there.
text_cn: 当他临近巴斯加玛时， 将约纳堂杀死，就埋葬在那里。

text_en: Then Trypho turned and went back to his own land.
text_cn: 特黎丰就回国去了。

text_en: Simon sent and took the bones of his brother Jonathan, and buried him in Modein, the city of his ancestors.
text_cn: 息孟遣人去运回他兄弟的骨骸，将他埋葬在他祖先的摩丁城里。

text_en: All Israel bewailed him with great lamentation, and mourned for him many days.
text_cn: 全以色列都举哀痛吊他，哀哭多日。

text_en: And Simon built a monument over the tomb of his father and his brothers; he made it high so that it might be seen, with polished stone at the front and back.
text_cn: 之后，息孟在他父亲与他兄弟们的坟墓上，用前后光泽的石头，修了一座相当高大的纪念碑，从远处可以望见。

text_en: He also erected seven pyramids, opposite one another, for his father and mother and four brothers.
text_cn: 他为父母和四个兄弟，还立了七座金字塔，彼此相对；

text_en: For the pyramids he devised an elaborate setting, erecting about them great columns, and on the columns he put suits of armor for a permanent memorial, and beside the suits of armor he carved ships, so that they could be seen by all who sail the sea.
text_cn: 且为塔作了一些装饰品，就是在四周，立了一些大石柱，石柱上刻了武器，作为永久的记念；又在武器旁，雕刻了船像，使航海的人都可以看到。

text_en: This is the tomb that he built in Modein; it remains to this day.
text_cn: 息孟在摩丁修建的这座坟墓，至今犹存。

text_en: Trypho dealt treacherously with the young King Antiochus; he killed him
text_cn: 特黎丰用诡计对待幼王安提约古，终于将幼王杀害，

text_en: and became king in his place, putting on the crown of Asia; and he brought great calamity on the land.
text_cn: 篡了王位，戴上亚细亚的王冠，使当地遭受到大害。

text_en: But Simon built up the strongholds of Judea and walled them all around, with high towers and great walls and gates and bolts, and he stored food in the strongholds.
text_cn: 息孟修建犹太各处的堡垒，全用高楼巨墙围起，安上门和闩，又在堡垒内储藏了粮食。

text_en: Simon also chose emissaries and sent them to King Demetrius with a request to grant relief to the country, for all that Trypho did was to plunder.
text_cn: 息孟然后选派几个人，去见德默特琉王，要求他豁免本地赋税，因为特黎丰的一切所为，无异劫掠。

text_en: King Demetrius sent him a favorable reply to this request, and wrote him a letter as follows,
text_cn: 德默特琉王便按照他的要求，给他写了下面的信，答复他说：

text_en: “King Demetrius to Simon, the high priest and friend of kings, and to the elders and nation of the Jews, greetings.
text_cn: “德默特琉王祝列王的朋友──息孟大司祭，长老及犹太民族安好！

text_en: We have received the gold crown and the palm branch that you sent, and we are ready to make a general peace with you and to write to our officials to grant you release from tribute.
text_cn: 你们送的金冠和金棕榈枝我们已经收到。我们业已准备好，要同你们尽力和好，要以书面通知官吏，豁免你们的赋税。

text_en: All the grants that we have made to you remain valid, and let the strongholds that you have built be your possession.
text_cn: 凡从前给你们规定的，仍为有效；你们修建的堡垒，仍归你们所有。

text_en: We pardon any errors and offenses committed to this day, and cancel the crown tax that you owe; and whatever other tax has been collected in Jerusalem shall be collected no longer.
text_cn: 截至今日止，你们无知的错误与罪过，我们都一律赦免，也豁免你们所应缴纳的王冠金；假如在耶路撒冷还有其他的杂税，也一概不再征收。

text_en: And if any of you are qualified to be enrolled in our bodyguard, let them be enrolled, and let there be peace between us. ”
text_cn: 如果你们中间，有适于作我们侍卫的人，都可录用；希望我们之间，常有和平。”

text_en: In the one hundred seventieth year the yoke of the Gentiles was removed from Israel,
text_cn: 一百七十年， 异民的重轭（è），由以色列人身上解除了。

text_en: and the people began to write in their documents and contracts, “In the first year of Simon the great high priest and commander and leader of the Jews. ”
text_cn: 民众于是在文书及契约上，开始写：犹太人的大司祭、大元帅、领袖息孟元年。

text_en: In those days Simon encamped against Gazara and surrounded it with troops. He made a siege engine, brought it up to the city, and battered and captured one tower.
text_cn: 那时，息孟安营攻打革则尔，派军队将城包围，也造了战楼，竖在城前，攻破了一座碉堡，而将城占领。

text_en: The men in the siege engine leaped out into the city, and a great tumult arose in the city.
text_cn: 战楼里的士兵，于是跃入城中，城中一时大乱。

text_en: The men in the city, with their wives and children, went up on the wall with their clothes torn, and they cried out with a loud voice, asking Simon to make peace with them;
text_cn: 城里的居民，撕破了衣服，带着妻子儿女上了城，大声呼喊，祈求息孟同他们讲和，

text_en: they said, “Do not treat us according to our wicked acts but according to your mercy. ”
text_cn: 说：“请不要照我们的恶行，对待我们，而照你的仁慈，对待我们吧！”

text_en: So Simon reached an agreement with them and stopped fighting against them. But he expelled them from the city and cleansed the houses in which the idols were located, and then entered it with hymns and praise.
text_cn: 息孟便与他们讲和，停止攻击，只把他们从城里赶走，将有偶像的房屋，都洗涤洁净；以后，唱着赞美诗与祝谢词进了城。

text_en: He removed all uncleanness from it, and settled in it those who observed the law. He also strengthened its fortifications and built in it a house for himself.
text_cn: 先清除城内一切不洁之物，然后使一些守法的人住在里面，并加强防御工事，也在里面为自己修了一座房屋。

text_en: Those who were in the citadel at Jerusalem were prevented from going in and out to buy and sell in the country. So they were very hungry, and many of them perished from famine.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷堡垒里的人，因不能在那地区出入买卖，非常饥饿，甚至有很多人饿死了。

text_en: Then they cried to Simon to make peace with them, and he did so. But he expelled them from there and cleansed the citadel from its pollutions.
text_cn: 他们于是呼求息孟讲和，息孟就同他们讲和；将他们由堡垒赶出，扫除了秽物，清洁了堡垒。

text_en: On the twenty-third day of the second month, in the one hundred seventy-first year, the Jews entered it with praise and palm branches, and with harps and cymbals and stringed instruments, and with hymns and songs, because a great enemy had been crushed and removed from Israel.
text_cn: 一百七十一年二月二十三日， 犹太人兴高彩烈地，拿着棕榈枝，弹着琴瑟，敲着铙钹，拉着提琴，唱着诗歌，进入堡垒，因为大仇敌已从以色列肃清。

text_en: Simon decreed that every year they should celebrate this day with rejoicing. He strengthened the fortifications of the temple hill alongside the citadel, and he and his men lived there.
text_cn: 息孟规定每年要欢乐地庆祝这一天。他又加强靠近堡垒的圣殿山，便与部下住在那里。

text_en: Simon saw that his son John had reached manhood, and so he made him commander of all the forces; and he lived at Gazara.
text_cn: 息孟见自己的儿子若望已经成人，于是派他作全军统帅，叫他驻扎在革则尔。
